# hitachi_vsp_nvme (Data Source)

Datasource to show NVM subsystem info in Hitachi VSP storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
#
# Hitachi VSP NVM Subsystem Data Retrieval
#
# This section defines a data source block to fetch information about a specific
# NVM Subsystem from a Hitachi Virtual Storage Platform (VSP) using
# HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL).
#
# The data source block "hitachi_vsp_nvme" retrieves details about the NVM 
# subsystem associated with the provided parameters. This allows you to access 
# configuration, associated namespaces (LDEVs), host NQNs, and path mappings.
#
# Provide the storage system serial number and the NVM subsystem ID.
#

#####################
# Example: NVM Subsystem Lookup
data "hitachi_vsp_nvme" "nvme" {
  serial           = var.serial_number
  nvm_subsystem_id = 1
}

output "nvme_subsystems" {
  description = "List of NVM subsystem info"
  value       = data.hitachi_vsp_nvme.nvme.nvm_subsystems
}

output "nvme_count" {
  description = "Total number of NVM subsystems returned"
  value       = data.hitachi_vsp_nvme.nvme.nvm_subsystem_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nvm_subsystem_id` (Number) NVM subsystem ID.
- `serial` (Number) Serial number of the storage system.

### Optional

- `nvm_subsystems` (Block List) NVM subsystem info. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--nvm_subsystems))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nvm_subsystem_count` (Number) Total number of NVM subsystems returned.

<a id="nestedblock--nvm_subsystems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nvm_subsystems`

Optional:

- `namespaces` (Block List) List of namespaces created in the NVM subsystem. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--nvm_subsystems--namespaces))

Read-Only:

- `host_mode` (String) Host mode of the NVM subsystem.
- `host_mode_options` (List of Number) List of host mode option numbers set for the NVM subsystem.
- `host_nqns` (Block List) List of Host NQNs registered to this subsystem. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--nvm_subsystems--host_nqns))
- `namespace_security_setting` (String) Namespace security settings (Enable, Disable, or Unknown).
- `nvm_subsystem_id` (Number) NVM subsystem ID.
- `nvm_subsystem_name` (String) NVM subsystem name.
- `nvm_subsystem_nqn` (String) Subsystem NQN. If virtualized, outputs the virtualized NQN.
- `port_ids` (List of String) List of registered port IDs (e.g., CL1-A).
- `resource_group_id` (Number) Resource group ID of the resource group to which the NVM subsystem belongs.
- `t10_pi_mode` (String) Status of the T10 PI mode of the port (Enable, Disable, or Unknown).
- `virtual_nvm_subsystem_id` (Number) Virtual NVM subsystem ID. Output for VSP 5000 series storage systems.

<a id="nestedblock--nvm_subsystems--namespaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nvm_subsystems.namespaces`

Optional:

- `namespace_nickname` (String) Nickname for the namespace.
- `paths` (List of String) List of Host NQNs that have access to this namespace.

Read-Only:

- `ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number associated with the namespace.
- `ldev_id_hex` (String) LDEV hexadecimal number associated with the namespace.
- `namespace_id` (Number) The Namespace ID.


<a id="nestedblock--nvm_subsystems--host_nqns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nvm_subsystems.host_nqns`

Read-Only:

- `host_nqn` (String) The NVMe Qualified Name (NQN) of the host.
- `host_nqn_id` (String) The unique identifier for the Host NQN.
- `host_nqn_nickname` (String) The nickname assigned to the Host NQN.
